onChange.script:
# Put the defaults into the form, unless an operation is being edited
	d = currentValue.value if currentValue else None
	if not d or self.custom.editing:
		return
	form = self.custom.form
	form.assetPath = d['assetPath']
	form.inputQty = d['inputQty']
	form.outputMode = d['outputMode']
	form.outputQty = d['outputQty']
	form.itemId = d['itemId']
	form.itemUnitId = d['itemUnitId']
	form.lotStateId = d['lotStateId']
	form.transportId = d['transportId']
	form.lotStateReasonId = None
	form.lotName = self.custom.serialPreview or ''
	form.comment = ''

# A same-lot output (Transfer, Inspect) moves the input's quantity: keep it in step with the input Qty while it
	# still shows the input's old quantity (or none), so an output quantity typed on purpose isn't overwritten
	form = self.custom.form
	if form.outputMode != 'same' or self.custom.outputEdit is not None: return
	previous = previousValue.value if previousValue else None
	if not form.outputQty or form.outputQty == previous:
		form.outputQty = currentValue.value

# The lot chosen in the Lot dropdown becomes the input lot, all of what's available to start with.
	# For the list entry being edited, its own lot keeps the entry's quantity.
	key = currentValue.value if currentValue else None
	if not key:
		self.custom.inputLot = None
		return
	lot = self.custom.inputEdit
	editing = lot is not None and '%s|%s|%s|%s' % (lot['lotId'], lot['assetId'], lot['lotStateId'], lot.get('lotStateReasonId')) == key
	for row in self.custom.inputLotOptions or []:
		if row['value'] == key:
			lot = dict(row)
			del lot['value'], lot['label']
			self.custom.inputLot = lot
			self.custom.form.inputQty = self.custom.inputEdit['inputQty'] if editing else lot['qty']
			return
	if editing:
		self.custom.inputLot = dict(lot)   # a saved input whose lot has no stock left now

# Lots with stock, one per asset, lot state and reason: what an input can consume. Reloads after each run.
	rows = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotActivity({'hasQty': True, 'enabled': True}))
	options = []
	for lot in rows:
		path = (lot['assetPath'] or '').split('\\')
		location = '\\'.join(path[2:]) if len(path) > 2 else (lot['assetPath'] or '')
		state = ' / '.join(x for x in (lot['lotStateName'], lot['lotStateReasonName']) if x)
		options.append({
			'value': '%s|%s|%s|%s' % (lot['lotId'], lot['assetId'], lot['lotStateId'], lot['lotStateReasonId']),
			'label': '%s  %s  at %s: %s %s %s' % (lot['lotName'], lot['itemName'], location, lot['lotEventQty'], lot['itemUnitName'], state),
			'lotId': lot['lotId'], 'lotName': lot['lotName'], 'itemId': lot['itemId'], 'itemName': lot['itemName'],
			'itemDescription': lot['itemDescription'] or '',
			'qty': lot['lotEventQty'] or 0, 'itemUnitId': lot['itemUnitId'], 'itemUnitName': lot['itemUnitName'],
			'assetId': lot['assetId'], 'assetPath': lot['assetPath'], 'location': location,
			'lotStateId': lot['lotStateId'], 'lotStateName': lot['lotStateName'],
			'lotStateReasonId': lot['lotStateReasonId'], 'lotStateReasonName': lot['lotStateReasonName'],
			'assetTransportId': lot['assetTransportId'], 'transport': lot['assetTransportName'] or '',
		})
	return sorted(options, key=lambda o: o['label'])

onChange.script:
# One row selected: put it in the form to edit. Otherwise the form adds a new input.
	# The selection only has the table's columns, so the entry is the first one showing the same values.
	picked = self.custom.inputSelection   # the live property: currentValue's rows have no keys()
	self.custom.inputEdit = None
	if not picked or len(picked) != 1:
		return
	row = picked[0]
	for item in self.custom.inputs:
		if all(item.get(field) == row[field] for field in row.keys()):
			self.custom.inputEdit = item
			lot = item
			self.custom.inputLotKey = '%s|%s|%s|%s' % (lot['lotId'], lot['assetId'], lot['lotStateId'], lot.get('lotStateReasonId'))
			self.custom.form.inputQty = item['inputQty']
			return

# A new operation starts with empty input and output lists, and nothing to add to
	self.custom.lastRun = None
	self.custom.appendTo = None
	if self.custom.editing:
		return
	self.custom.inputs = []
	self.custom.outputs = []

customMethods.name: inputFromForm
customMethods.script:
# An input from the input lot and quantity: a new one, or the list entry being edited (it keeps its key and saved lot
	# event, and takes the lot chosen). Returns (error, None) or (None, input).
	def bucket(lot):
		return (lot['lotId'], lot['assetId'], lot['lotStateId'], lot.get('lotStateReasonId'))
	edit = self.view.custom.inputEdit
	chosen = self.view.custom.inputLot
	lot = dict(chosen) if chosen else (dict(edit) if edit else None)
	qty = self.view.custom.form.inputQty
	if lot is None:
		return 'Choose the input lot.', None
	# The lot the form holds must be the one the Lot dropdown shows: onStartup sets the lot passed in before the dropdown has
	# its options, so a dropdown left blank mustn't run on a lot the user can't see (868mvhbex)
	if chosen and self.view.custom.inputLotKey != '%s|%s|%s|%s' % bucket(lot):
		return 'Choose the input lot.', None
	available = lot.get('qty')   # entries loaded from a saved operation don't carry it
	if edit:
		# Stock now doesn't count what the entry's saved lot event already takes from the same lot
		if available is not None and edit.get('lotEventId') and bucket(lot) == bucket(edit):
			available += edit['inputQty']
		lot['key'] = edit['key']
		lot['lotEventId'] = edit.get('lotEventId')
	if (qty or 0) <= 0 or (available is not None and qty > available):
		if available is None:
			return 'Enter an input quantity greater than 0.', None
		return 'Enter an input quantity greater than 0 and no more than the %s %s of %s available.' % (available, lot['itemUnitName'], lot['lotName']), None
	lot['inputQty'] = qty
	lot['key'] = lot.get('key') or system.kanoa.utilities.getUUID()
	return None, lot

customMethods.name: outputFromForm
customMethods.script:
# An output from the output fields. Returns (error, None) or (None, output).
	form = self.view.custom.form
	edit = self.view.custom.outputEdit   # the list entry being edited: it keeps its key, its lot and its saved lot event
	lot = edit['lot'] if edit and edit['mode'] in ('same', 'existing') else self.view.custom.inputLot
	def labels(options):
		return dict((o['value'], o['label']) for o in options)
	states = labels(self.view.custom.stateOptions)
	reasons = labels(self.view.custom.reasonOptions)
	transports = labels(self.view.custom.transportOptions)
	units = labels(self.view.custom.unitOptions)
	items = labels(self.view.custom.opInfo['itemOptions'])
	if (form.outputQty or 0) <= 0:
		return 'Enter an output quantity greater than 0.', None
	if form.lotStateId is None:
		return 'Choose a lot state for the output.', None
	output = {
		'key': edit['key'] if edit else system.kanoa.utilities.getUUID(),
		'mode': 'existing' if edit and edit['mode'] == 'existing' else form.outputMode, 'qty': form.outputQty,
		'assetPath': None,
		'lotStateId': form.lotStateId, 'state': states.get(form.lotStateId),
		'lotStateReasonId': form.lotStateReasonId, 'reason': reasons.get(form.lotStateReasonId),
		'transportId': form.transportId, 'transport': transports.get(form.transportId),
		'comment': (form.comment or '').strip(),
	}
	if edit and edit.get('lotEventId'):
		output['lotEventId'] = edit['lotEventId']
	if form.outputMode == 'same':
		if lot is None:
			return 'Choose the input lot that the output continues.', None
		output.update({'lot': dict(lot), 'lotName': lot['lotName'], 'itemName': lot['itemName'], 'unit': lot['itemUnitName']})
		return None, output
	lotName = '' if form.serialId is not None else (form.lotName or '').strip()
	if form.itemId is None or form.itemUnitId is None:
		return 'Choose the item and unit for the new lot.', None
	if not lotName and form.serialId is None:
		return 'Enter a lot name for the new lot, or choose a serialization to name it.', None
	if lotName and len(system.kanoa.lot.getLots({'lotName': lotName})) > 0:
		return 'Lot %s already exists. Choose it as the input lot and output the same lot instead.' % lotName, None
	output.update({'itemId': form.itemId, 'itemName': items.get(form.itemId), 'itemUnitId': form.itemUnitId, 'unit': units.get(form.itemUnitId),
		'serialId': form.serialId, 'newLotName': lotName, 'lotName': lotName or '(next serial number)'})
	return None, output

customMethods.name: editOperation
customMethods.script:
# Load an operation event into the form for editing (the trace graph's operation node click)
	def toast(kind, message):
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': kind, 'message': message})

	self.view.custom.lastRun = None
	self.view.custom.appendTo = None
	events = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotEvents({'lotOperationEventId': lotOperationEventId}))
	if not events:
		toast('warning', 'This operation has no lot events.')
		return
	t = events[0]['operationtStamp']
	timeFormat = system.kanoa.date.localizeDateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', self.session.props.locale)
	# A time as the user's device shows it: system.date.format uses the gateway's timezone
	shown = system.date.format(system.date.addMinutes(t, -system.kanoa.date.getClientOffsetMinsFromGateway(self.session.props.device.timezone.id, t)), timeFormat) if t else ''
	self.view.custom.editing = {'lotOperationEventId': lotOperationEventId, 'originalTime': t,
		'label': '%s at %s, %s' % (events[0]['lotOperationName'], events[0]['operationAssetPath'] or '', shown)}
	self.view.custom.operation = events[0]['lotOperationName']
	def location(path):
		return path or ''
	inputs, outputs = [], []
	for e in events:
		lot = {'lotId': e['lotId'], 'lotName': e['lotName'], 'itemId': e['itemId'], 'itemName': e['itemName'], 'itemUnitId': e['itemUnitId'], 'itemUnitName': e['itemUnitName']}
		if e['itemSourceName'] == 'input':
			inputs.append(dict(lot, key=system.kanoa.utilities.getUUID(), lotEventId=e['lotEventId'], inputQty=e['lotEventQty'],
				assetId=e['assetId'], assetPath=e['assetPath'], location=location(e['assetPath']),
				assetTransportId=e['assetTransportId'], transport=e['assetTransportName'] or '', lotStateId=e['lotStateId']))
		else:
			outputs.append({'key': system.kanoa.utilities.getUUID(), 'mode': 'existing', 'lotEventId': e['lotEventId'], 'lot': lot,
				'lotName': e['lotName'], 'itemName': e['itemName'], 'unit': e['itemUnitName'], 'qty': e['lotEventQty'],
				'assetPath': e['assetPath'], 'location': location(e['assetPath']),
				'transportId': e['assetTransportId'], 'transport': e['assetTransportName'] or '',
				'lotStateId': e['lotStateId'], 'state': e['lotStateName'], 'lotStateReasonId': e['lotStateReasonId'], 'reason': e['lotStateReasonName'],
				'comment': e['comment'] or ''})
	self.view.custom.inputs = inputs
	self.view.custom.outputs = outputs
	self.view.custom.removedLotEventIds = []
	form = self.view.custom.form
	form.assetPath = events[0]['operationAssetPath']
	form.useNow = False
	form.tStamp = events[0]['operationtStamp']
	form.orderName = ([e['workOrderName'] for e in events if e['workOrderName']] or [''])[0]

messageHandlers.script:
# Delete the operation, unless a lot it made has been used since
	def toast(kind, message):
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': kind, 'message': message})
	target = self.view.custom.pendingDelete
	self.view.custom.pendingDelete = None
	if payload.get('userInput') != 'OK' or not target or not self.view.custom.canEditLots:
		return
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	opEventId = target['lotOperationEventId']
	events = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotEvents({'lotOperationEventId': opEventId}))
	for e in events:
		if e['itemSourceName'] != 'output':
			continue
		later = [x for x in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.lot.getLotEvents({'lotId': e['lotId']})) if x['lotOperationEventId'] != opEventId]
		if any(x['tStamp'] is not None and system.date.isAfter(x['tStamp'], e['tStamp']) for x in later):
			toast('warning', "%s has been used by later operations. Delete those first, so its trace isn't broken." % e['lotName'])
			return
	for e in events:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.lot.deleteLotEvent(e['lotEventId'], userId)
		if msg:
			toast('error', "Couldn't delete the lot event for %s: %s" % (e['lotName'], msg))
			return
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.lot.deleteLotOperationEvent(opEventId, userId)
	if msg:
		toast('error', "Couldn't delete the operation: %s" % msg)
		return
	toast('success', 'Deleted the %s' % target['label'])
	editing = self.view.custom.editing
	if editing and editing['lotOperationEventId'] == opEventId:
		self.view.custom.editing = None
		self.view.custom.inputs = []
		self.view.custom.outputs = []
		self.view.custom.removedLotEventIds = []
		self.view.custom.form.useNow = True
	system.perspective.sendMessage('lotUpdate', {}, scope='page')
	system.perspective.closePopup('')

# The asset picked (or cleared) in the Asset selector
	form = self.view.custom.form
	if form.assetPath != payload['assetPath']:
		form.assetPath = payload['assetPath']
